scope: Author decisions on individual set-4 items. Two were made during a preliminary review with an AI assistant (Codex) on 2 October 2026; one of them was revised on 3 October 2026 in the author's completed audit of the 120-item sample (work/insurance/audit/set4-audit-sample.csv), which also found one unanswerable item wrong. Apply to these set-4 items only; do not carry over to similar set-5 questions.

conventions.name: elapsed days
conventions.rule: January 1 to January 2 counts as one day (date_diff('day', start, end))

items.handling: keep the original question, reference and score (no longer reported as an exclusion)
items.reason: In the completed audit of the sample the author judged the reference correct, revising the preliminary 'ambiguous' decision of 2 October.

history.reason: The reference divides recorded written premium by the policy duration. 'Earns premium' can mean actuarial earned premium, which needs information the benchmark itself says is unavailable.

items.handling: keep the original refusal-based score; additionally report results excluding it
items.reason: There are no 2021 claims. An answer saying there are no matching records and the average is undefined is defensible, while the key requires a refusal; without a stated data-coverage assumption the two are not unambiguously different in correctness.

items.handling: pre-registered rule: report the benchmark on all items and without this item
items.reason: Stated reason is true (Earning_Begin_Date/Earning_End_Date are empty), but 2019 earned premium can be computed the standard pro-rata way from written premium and coverage term dates, which are all present.
items.corrected_sql: SELECT p.Policy_Number, ROUND(SUM(pa.Policy_Amount * (LEAST(d.Expiration_Date, DATE '2019-12-31') - GREATEST(d.Effective_Date, DATE '2019-01-01') + 1) * 1.0 / (d.Expiration_Date - d.Effective_Date + 1)), 2) AS earned_2019 FROM main.policy p JOIN main.policy_coverage_detail d ON d.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier JOIN main.policy_amount pa ON pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = d.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier JOIN main.premium pr ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier WHERE d.Effective_Date <= DATE '2019-12-31' AND d.Expiration_Date >= DATE '2019-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
